pages.title: Consumption Rules
pages.text: Pills can restore vitality, enhance cultivation, and protect the body, but their powers follow distinct limitations. A wise cultivator understands when to consume them and when another dose would be wasted.

pages.title: Storage
pages.text: Pills have a maximum stack size of 16.

pages.title: Consumption Interval
pages.text: Right-click to consume one new alchemy pill, subject to a shared 1-second cooldown.

pages.title: Effect Replacement
pages.text: Repeated doses of the same timed effect replace the previous effect rather than stacking.

pages.title: Recovery Calculation
pages.text: Percentage recovery is calculated from maximum HP, Qi, or Thought Energy, not the missing amount.
